---
title: "Mostly Monte Carlo Seminar Series"
---

A monthly seminar (mostly) on the theory and practice of Monte Carlo in statistics and data science.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

Held on the **2nd Friday of each month** \(approximately\) at the **PariSanté Campus**.

Organised by Cameron Bell and [Shiva Darshan](https://shiva-darshan.github.io/)

Organisers emeriti: Andrea Bertazzi, [Joshua Bon](https://bonstats.github.io), [Antoine Luciano](https://sites.google.com/view/aluciano), and Timothy Johnston.
